usage: Use 海 (hoi2) for the sea as a natural body of salt water; it is a basic everyday noun.
Commonly appears in place names, scenery descriptions, and simple travel talk, like going to the seaside or talking about the ocean.
Can combine with related words such as 海邊, 海水, and 大海; 海 is the shorter, more general word.
In spoken Cantonese, 海 is neutral and very common; for a bigger, more poetic feel, people may also say 大海.
